extracted text: The paper studies AA2219 aluminum alloy, an Al-Cu alloy used in aerospace applications, particularly for cryogenic propellant tanks. The study examines the effect of different thermomechanical processing conditions on microstructure and mechanical properties. The starting material is AA2219-T87 plate. The main processing conditions include: 1) without solution treatment + cryorolling (WST-CR), 2) solution treatment + cryorolling (ST+CR), and 3) solution treatment + cryorolling + annealing (CR+Annealed). Solution treatment was performed at 808 K (535°C) for 1 hour followed by water quenching. Annealing was done at 623 K (350°C) for 1 hour. The paper mentions CuAl2 (θ') precipitates as the main strengthening phase in AA2219.
